%q 不是 Ctrl、Alt、Shift，只能放在最后: %q is not Ctrl, Alt or Shift, so it can only go last
Win 的组合 Windows 自己留着用，不能当老板键: Win combinations are reserved by Windows and cannot be a boss key
写成 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+1 这样：Ctrl、Alt、Shift 至少: Write it like Ctrl+Alt+Shift+1: include at least one of Ctrl, Alt, Shift, ending with a key such as a digit, a letter, F1-F24 or Num0-Num9; write none for no boss key
实例 %d 的 %s 不是字符串，当作不要老板键: %s of instance %d is not a string; treated as no boss key
实例 %d 的老板键 %q 不对，当作不要老板键: The boss key %q of instance %d is invalid; treated as no boss key
缺少 Ctrl、Alt、Shift 以外的那个按键: The key other than Ctrl, Alt and Shift is missing
至少要带 Ctrl、Alt、Shift 中的一个: Include at least one of Ctrl, Alt, Shift
